notes.title: February Dev Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors!

We know it’s been a while since our last update—our last post was during Christmas. The reason? We’ve been completely immersed in intensive development, working hard to bring the best experience possible to Robinson Crusoe. Thank you for your patience! 

[h1]Gameplay Enhancements[/h1]

[h2]AI Overhaul[/h2]
[b]Enemies now react more intelligently[/b] to sound and movement.
[b]Sneaking is more challenging[/b]—enemies will search the area when alerted.
Once spotted, they will rush at you immediately!

[h2]Historical Firearms[/h2]
[b]We’re introducing muskets and pistols[/b] with historically accurate animations.
Firearms aren’t just for combat—you can also use them to intimidate enemies!

[h2]UI & Inventory Revamp[/h2]
Based on your feedback, [b]we’re overhauling the inventory, game map, and menus[/b].
The new system will improve player communication with the game’s AI.

[h1]Story & Immersion[/h1]

[b]We’re working hard on Chapter 1[/b], focusing on immersion and authentic storytelling.
From the shipwreck to first contact with a savage civilization, we’re staying faithful to the book while adding new twists.

To improve cinematic sequences, we’re using an Xsens MoCap suit, one of the best motion capture systems available.

[h1]Technical Optimization[/h1]

[b]We’re fine-tuning game performance[/b] to balance visual quality and smooth gameplay.

[b]Code optimizations & world design adjustments[/b] will ensure your system isn’t under unnecessary strain.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

We’re continuing to refine these features and will share more updates soon! Thank you for your patience while we focused on development. Let us know what you think in the comments!

Follow us for more updates, and stay tuned for more survival adventures!

notes.title: 🌟 Adventure Awaits in 2025 🗺️
notes.content:
From all of us at Infilope Games, we wish you a year filled with new horizons, exciting challenges, and unforgettable discoveries.

Thank you for being part of our story — we can’t wait to explore the next chapter together.

notes.title: Robinson Crusoe goes to GDS Prague 2024! 🚶‍♂️
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Infilope Games will be at Game Developers Session - GDS, December 13–14, showcasing our latest project: Robinson Crusoe! 🎮🌴

Come visit us at our booth in the Indie section, where you can:
✅ Play Robinson Crusoe and explore its immersive survival adventure.
✅ Meet the team behind the game and learn about its creation.
✅ Support us on Hithit.cz and get an exclusive Robinson Crusoe T-shirt immediately—no waiting for the campaign to end! 👕

We can’t wait to meet fellow gamers, developers, and fans, and share this exciting journey with you. Your support means the world to us, and we’re honored to bring this incredible project to life!

📅 Mark your calendars: December 13–14, 2024
📍 Where: Indie Section, GDS Prague

See you there! 🚀

notes.title: 🎮 The Demo Is Gone! 🏝️
notes.content:
You may have noticed that our demo has disappeared from Steam. No, it’s not a coincidence or a marketing intern’s accidental click—it was intentional! ✅

First, we want to give a HUGE thank you to everyone who played the demo during CZ/SK Week. Your feedback, advice, and opinions were incredibly valuable. 🙌 But now it’s time to move forward—we’ve taken the demo as far as it can go and are diving back into full development of the game! 🚀

Missing Robinson? Don’t worry! 🛠️ Our Hithit crowdfunding campaign is still running, and by supporting us, you’ll gain exclusive access to the game’s development builds. 🎁 Want in? Head to Hithit, support the project, and email us at marketing@infilope.com to claim your access! 💌

For everyone else, get ready for Steam Next Fest, where we’ll showcase an updated and action-packed demo with brand-new mechanics and quests! 🔥

👉 Follow us and don’t forget to add Robinson Crusoe to your Steam wishlist! 🛒
